title: Brain fog on a loop?
caption: Brain fog on a loop? Today feels calmer, like a smooth path with a few little dips—room to recoup without pushing. Pick one easy anchor task, and step outside for a short light break.
snapshot: Geomagnetic conditions are quiet and the solar wind is in a normal range. No significant flares were seen. A handful of CMEs were observed and sit as background context. Aurora chances remain low.
affects: Some people may feel steadier energy with brief dips. Brain fog may lift in short runs. Sleep can come easier if the evening stays simple and calm.
playbook:
- Plan one gentle anchor task
- Add a short outdoor light break
- Sip water and keep meals steady
- Check local weather shifts and air quality
- Keep your evening routine short and repeatable
